inputs.name: FASTQ sequence reads
inputs.description: Text-based sequence read format with quality scores. Standard input for all BWA alignment commands (mem, aln, bwasw). Supports gzip-compressed input (.fq.gz, .fastq.gz) via kseq library. Supports Sanger (ASCII-33) and legacy Illumina 1.3+ (ASCII-64, -I flag) quality encodings. Supports standard and interleaved paired-end reads (-p flag).

edam.verification_source: EDAM ontology ID format_1930 documented at https://edamontology.org/format_1930; cannot access EDAM.owl programmatically within repository constraints

evidence.description: Man page synopsis examples: 'bwa mem ref.fa reads.fq > aln-se.sam' and 'bwa mem ref.fa read1.fq read2.fq > aln-pe.sam'
Usage string: 'Usage: bwa fastmap [options] <idxbase> <in.fq>'
FAQ section documenting FASTQ input for all read types and sequencing platforms
Documentation of -I flag (Illumina 1.3+ ASCII-64) and -p flag (interleaved pairing)

inputs.name: FASTA reference sequence
inputs.description: Text-based sequence format for reference genome. Required input for 'bwa index' command to construct FM-index. Supports gzip-compressed input (.fa.gz, .fasta.gz). Single or multiple reference sequences per file.

edam.verification_source: EDAM ontology ID format_1929 documented at https://edamontology.org/format_1929; cannot access EDAM.owl programmatically within repository constraints

evidence.description: Index command documentation: 'Index database sequences in the FASTA format.'
bwa_index() function expects FASTA input; processes via bns_fasta2bntseq()
Getting started: './bwa index ref.fa'

inputs.name: BAM sequence reads
inputs.description: Binary compressed format containing sequence reads (not alignments). Alternative input to FASTQ for 'bwa aln' command with -b flag. Requires reads to be name-grouped for paired-end data. Paired reads selected via -0 (single-end only), -1 (first read), or -2 (second read).

edam.verification_source: EDAM ontology ID format_2573 documented at https://edamontology.org/format_2573; cannot access EDAM.owl programmatically within repository constraints

evidence.description: -b flag documentation: 'Specify the input read sequence file is the BAM format. For paired-end data, two ends in a pair must be grouped together and options -1 or -2 are usually applied.'
Usage help: '-b        the input read file is in the BAM format'

outputs.name: SAM alignment records
outputs.description: Text-based sequence alignment format. Primary output of all BWA alignment commands (bwa mem, bwa aln via samse/sampe, bwa bwasw). Tab-delimited records with mandatory fields QNAME, FLAG, RNAME, POS, MAPQ, CIGAR, RNEXT, PNEXT, TLEN, SEQ, QUAL. Includes standard optional fields (NM, MD) and BWA-specific optional fields (AS, XA, XS, XN, XM, XO, XG, XT). Default output to stdout; redirected with -o or -f flag.

edam.verification_source: EDAM ontology ID format_2572 documented at https://edamontology.org/format_2572; cannot access EDAM.owl programmatically within repository constraints

evidence.description: Comprehensive SAM format specification documenting all mandatory fields, SAM flags, and optional tags
mem_aln2sam() function generates complete SAM records with mandatory and optional fields
Example commands showing SAM output: 'bwa mem ref.fa reads.fq > aln.sam'

outputs.name: BWA FM-index reference files
outputs.description: Five binary files forming the FM-index for reference genome. Created by 'bwa index' command. Required for all alignment operations. Components: .bwt (Burrows-Wheeler Transform), .pac (2-bit packed sequence), .sa (sampled suffix array), .ann (sequence annotations), .amb (ambiguous base positions). All five files must exist together.

edam.verification_source: format_3327 is closest available EDAM term; BWA FM-index is proprietary format without specific EDAM definition

evidence.description: bwa_idx_build() creates .pac (packed sequence), .bwt (BWT), .sa (suffix array), .ann and .amb (annotations/ambiguous) files via bns_fasta2bntseq() and BWT construction
File existence verification: 'unless (-f "$idx.bwt" && -f "$idx.pac" && -f "$idx.sa" && -f "$idx.ann" && -f "$idx.amb")'
Index command documentation describes FM-index output components

outputs.name: SAI suffix array indices (BWA-backtrack intermediate)
outputs.description: Binary intermediate format produced by 'bwa aln' command containing suffix array coordinates of input reads. Used as input to 'bwa samse' (single-end) or 'bwa sampe' (paired-end) to generate SAM output. Specific to BWA-backtrack algorithm. Transient intermediate file.

edam.verification_source: format_3327 is closest available EDAM term; SAI is proprietary BWA format without specific EDAM definition

evidence.description: Man page examples and description: 'bwa aln ref.fa short_read.fq > aln_sa.sai' with note 'Find the SA coordinates of the input reads'
BWA-backtrack workflow: 'bwa aln ref.fa reads.fq > reads.sai; bwa samse ref.fa reads.sai reads.fq > aln-se.sam'
bwa_sai2sam_se_core() reads SAI format; checks SAI magic and reads coordinates

outputs.name: BAM alignments (bwakit pipeline only)
outputs.description: Binary compressed alignment format. OUTPUT OF BWAKIT PIPELINE ONLY; NOT CORE BWA OUTPUT. Produced by bwakit run-bwamem script piping SAM output through samtools for BAM conversion. Contains alignment records. Generated externally; not directly by BWA core commands.

edam.verification_source: EDAM ontology ID format_2573 documented at https://edamontology.org/format_2573; cannot access EDAM.owl programmatically within repository constraints

evidence.description: Output file documentation: '* `out.aln.bam`: unsorted alignments with ALT-aware mapping quality.'
Pipeline output files: '{-o}.aln.bam - final alignment'

outputs.name: HLA genotype predictions
outputs.description: Plain text HLA typing reports. OUTPUT OF BWAKIT PIPELINE ONLY; NOT CORE BWA OUTPUT. Two files generated when -H flag specified: .hla.top contains best genotypes for six classical HLA genes (A, B, C, DQA1, DQB1, DRB1); .hla.all contains alternative predictions. Format not documented in repository; generated by external HLA typing module.

edam.verification_source: No EDAM term exists for HLA genotype prediction reports; domain-specific output format

evidence.description: '* `out.hla.top`: best genotypes for HLA-A, -B, -C, -DQA1, -DQB1 and -DRB1 genes.' and '* `out.hla.all`: other possible genotypes on the six HLA genes.'
Output files: '{-o}.hla.top - best genotypes for the 6 classical HLA genes' and '{-o}.hla.all - additional HLA genotypes consistent with data'

outputs.name: Pipeline log files (bwakit only)
outputs.description: Diagnostic log files. OUTPUT OF BWAKIT PIPELINE ONLY; NOT CORE BWA OUTPUT. Generated by bwakit run-bwamem pipeline with multiple log files for different tools (bwa-mem, samblaster, HLA typing). Contains progress messages, timing information, and warnings.
